component.name: Sysmon
component.summary: System monitor with live charts and alerts

description.p: Sysmon watches a Linux machine and shows what it is doing right now: CPU, memory, disks, network and processes, drawn as live charts that keep a short history so a spike is still visible after it happened.

Alerts are defined per metric with a threshold and hysteresis, so a value hovering around the limit does not produce a stream of duplicate warnings. Every alert is appended to a log you can read later.
The same engine is also available as a terminal interface for servers without a desktop.

Sysmon is free to download and use with its built-in feature set. Paid plans, purchased on the developer's website and activated inside the application, unlock the extended features; no payment is taken through this store and no account is required for the free features.
